summary: Operator site read (home, reservation, rules and map pages): 36 full-hookup lots 45x95 ft, RVs, campers and mobile homes, no tents, books by day/week/month/season via a request form. The 2026 rules/rates PDF and camp map PDF 404 to a plain fetch: rates UNREAD. Google 4.1 (32). Not waterfront confirmed (river about 350 m south across a field).
flags: PRICE GATE: operator rates UNREAD (the 2026 rules/rates PDF linked from /rules/ answers 404 to a plain fetch; I did not retry around it). No operator figure anywhere. Third-party only: Campendium 'Last Nightly Rate $30' (undated, aggregator), RV Life $$ (stored price_tier 2, i.e. under about $40), ParkAdvisor $$, AllStays $$$$. Nothing suggests over $50, but no operator-posted rate was read; reviewer may want the PDF read by hand.

LONG-STAY (five tests), borderline, not decided: operator wording 'We welcome Rv's, Camper's and Mobile Homes' and 'You can book by the day, week, month, or season'; imagery shows mobile homes/park models among the RV rows. Nightly stays are offered (test 4 needs 1 site in 10 sold nightly: the operator's own words offer the day, and AllStays lists 19 sites, matching the old note's '~19 sites offered nightly', but no source read today gives the nightly share). Google 4.1 from 32 reviews is above 4.0, so the 'under 4 stars + borderline seasonal' auto-drop does not apply. Reviewer to decide whether the mobile-home share makes it residential.
Google Maps: 'Bluffview Campground', 4.1 from 32 reviews, 507-450-7195; Google's pin 43.80670,-91.76144 is about 150 m NE of the stored pin.

Phone: stored 507-450-7195 matches the operator's contact block ('5074507195') and Google. Website https://bluffviewcampground.com/ answers HTTP 403 to a scripted fetch but serves the full page body; it is this campground.
Pin 43.80560,-91.76250 sits on the highway frontage about 70 m south of the camper rows; under 250 m, no move needed (a closer point is about 43.8064,-91.7615).

Waterfront: confirmed not waterfront. The rows sit north of Hwy 16; the Root River is about 350 m south across a crop field and a tree band. The operator's 'We are located on the Root River bike trail and the Root River' is marketing wording, not site-level water.
Amperage not stated by the operator (stored hookups has no electric; AllStays says 30 amp, Campendium 50 amp, aggregators only). Not written.
